title: SDCC teaser gives us our first good look at Blade Runner 2099
summary: Prime Video debuted the first teaser for the new ten-episode series, Blade Runner 2099, at San Diego Comic-Con on Friday. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner.
